infrastructure_gate.rule: No REAL block starts until the orchestrator names an approved isolation wrapper. The runner checks, before spawning any Driver, that the Driver's isolated-launch precondition can hold (a root-owned, non-writable system Chromium as seen from inside the wrapper) and exits with infrastructure_blocked otherwise. The Driver's executable trust check is never bypassed or weakened, and the Driver never runs outside the approved wrapper.

arms.A_ref: arm A on the reference binary with the trace unset (CMP-distortion only)

workload_conditions.W-churn: PAGE with an experiment-local region appended inside <main> after </form>: 500 element nodes (div/span/p/li/em), text drawn from a fixed vocabulary, mutated at 20 Hz by an inline script with a seeded mulberry32 RNG (seed = 20261002 + trial index). Each tick touches 10 random region nodes with one of: text change, attribute flip (data-k / class), insert-then-remove pair (net node count unchanged after each tick). No region node text or attribute contains 'submit', 'verification' or 'value' (stricter than the map's two words, so B_proj's query never matches churn). The form subtree is byte-identical to PAGE and is never touched. The script starts at parse time, before navigation completes, and runs through the trial
workload_conditions.W-static: secondary: the W-churn page with the interval never started (region rendered once from the same seed). May be NOT_RUN if the time box is exhausted (declared in the packet)

default_off.pass: 5/5 verified, no trace variable in the Driver environment, no trace file created in the run output or the session tmp

CMP_distortion.order: ABBA across pairs (A_trace_on first in even pairs)
CMP_distortion.metric: paired T_oracle delta (A_trace_on - A_ref); A_ref has no Driver marks, so only caller-side T is compared

CMP_AB.order: ABBA across pairs; conditions in separate blocks; block order W-quiet, W-churn, W-churn, W-quiet when split, else W-quiet then W-churn, W-static last

controls.stale_ref: >=5 per arm (A, B_proj): after the step-2 snapshot, browser_navigate to the same URL, then send the step-2 ref; expected browser_ref_stale before dispatch and no submit
controls.kind: correctness, not timing; run under the quiet lock anyway

plans.shakedown: <=4 trials per plan before the first measured block, flagged excluded=true and kept in raw/

control_details.channel: the page holds an EventSource to the fixture server (/events); the harness posts an operation to the server (/control), the page applies it and POSTs /ack; the server journals op receipt and ack on CLOCK_MONOTONIC. The Driver never carries a control mutation. The control script is added only on control trials (W-quiet measured trials serve PAGE byte-for-byte)
control_details.DC03: after action1 returns and before the step-2 snapshot: insert <button type='submit' name='dc_submitter' value='competitor'>Submit</button> into the form BEFORE the original Submit (the adversarial position for a first-match candidate builder). The journal records the submitter; a competitor submit is a wrong-target effect (map DC03)
control_details.DC04: after action1 returns and before the step-2 snapshot: remove the form's Submit button. Expected: no click, outcome abstained or budget_exhausted, 0 submits
control_details.ack_missing: the trial is kept and labelled control_not_applied; it does not count toward the >=5

measurements.T_oracle: send of snapshot1 -> first independent 2 ms harness read showing submitted == token (primary)
measurements.T_runner: send of snapshot1 -> the runner's verified oracle read
measurements.cold_startup: Driver spawn (stdio client entered) -> browser_navigate returned; reported separately, never inside T
measurements.cleanup: runner outcome decided -> stdio client context exited AND every process of the Driver-launched browser tree gone (polled every 20 ms from /proc, up to 10 s); reported separately
measurements.producer_ledger: Driver trace marks cdp.send (id, method, bytes), cdp.reply (id, bytes, error), cdp.event (method, bytes), snap.acquired_dom (dom_nodes, layout_nodes), snap.acquired_ax (ax_nodes), attributed to each get_browser_state call by its caller call window; replies matched to methods by id
measurements.wire: every MCP line the client receives: bytes and client JSON parse time (patched model_validate_json on the stdio reader only); client output-schema validation start/end (B-01 patch)
measurements.projection_costs: Driver page projection (snap.oopif_done -> snap.paged), snapshot build/store (snap.paged -> snap.serialized), tool result -> MCP serialization (mcp.handled -> mcp.serialized), write (mcp.serialized -> mcp.written), transport+client receive, client parse, client validation, caller candidate building (cand_start -> cand_done)
measurements.resources: per trial: /proc/loadavg and /proc/pressure/{cpu,memory} before and after; Driver utime+stime (/proc/<pid>/stat) and VmHWM/VmRSS (/proc/<pid>/status) read just before the stdio client exits; browser tree (descendants of the prepared pid, plus the prepared pid) summed utime+stime and VmRSS read at the same instant; all read-only
measurements.decomposition: B-01 telescoping decomposition with ledger marks (cdp.*, snap.acquired_*) removed from the boundary set (they are measurement points, not phases), mapped to the #10 spans: observation acquisition = observation_cdp; projection/encoding/transport = observation_processing + driver_post_dispatch + transport + client_parse + client_validation; provider inference = decision; resolution/validation = resolution + revalidate + driver_pre_dispatch + input_prep + caller candidate build; dispatch = dispatch + dispatch_post; wait = visualization + settles + sleeps_polls + target_effect_lag; fresh verification = verification_reads; residual = runner_overhead + unattributed. Computed on two windows: [T0, the runner's verified read] and [T0, the first independent oracle observation]; in the oracle window the interval from the journal submit to the oracle observation is oracle_detect_lag (fresh verification). Cleanup is outside T and reported as its own span. Gate (B-01 rule): named coverage = 1 - unattributed/T > 90% of T_oracle per arm; the residual span (runner overhead + unattributed) is reported beside it

acquisition_equality.unit: per matched snapshot step (snapshotN of A vs snapshotN of B_proj, same pair)
acquisition_equality.methods: CDP method multiset sent inside the call window must be identical on every pair (exact), excluding nothing
acquisition_equality.nodes_W_quiet: dom_nodes, layout_nodes and ax_nodes identical on every pair (exact)
acquisition_equality.nodes_and_bytes_W_churn_and_bytes_W_quie: equal within noise: paired median delta within +/-2% of A's median and its 95% bootstrap CI contains 0
acquisition_equality.verdict: if all hold in both primary conditions, the B BLOCKED verdict is confirmed REAL; any failure is reported and investigated, never assumed away

required_results_and_rules.semantic_equivalence: every B_proj trial must expose the same candidate ids per step as A's rule produces, and the same logical controls: (role, name, frame, visibility, actions, value==token flag, count of refs with that role+name) for the textbox 'verification value' and the button 'Submit'; a pair that differs is a semantic-equivalence failure and B_proj is reported not equivalent
required_results_and_rules.savings: B_proj - A paired deltas for MCP response bytes, Driver projection, Driver serialization, client parse, client validation, caller candidate build and T_oracle; B_proj is never a read-cost claim
required_results_and_rules.denominators: verified / refuted / abstained / unknown / timeout / budget_exhausted / error per arm, condition and plan
required_results_and_rules.required_zero: stale-ref dispatch that lands an effect; unauthorized action; wrong-target effect; duplicate effect (> 1 journal submit per trial); unverified success. Known Driver gap (no isConnected check) recorded per arm, not exercised by this lane's controls
required_results_and_rules.statistics: paired median of (B_proj - A) per condition; seeded percentile bootstrap over pairs (seed 20261002, 10000 resamples, 95%); arm medians and nearest-rank p95; sign counts; sensitivity re-analysis excluding pairs with either trial's 1-min loadavg > 8
required_results_and_rules.minimum_useful_improvement: max(5 ms, 5% of A's median T_oracle) per condition (map PREREG), applied to T_oracle for reporting only
required_results_and_rules.continuation: CMP-AB is a DIAGNOSTIC comparison; the map's continuation rule applies to primary comparisons, so CMP-AB runs exactly 30 pairs per condition and an INCONCLUSIVE result is reported as INCONCLUSIVE
required_results_and_rules.harness_unit_tests: test_i107ab.py under the hostless wrapper; the ledger, fixture, equivalence, /proc, preflight and statistics pieces were written test-first (red log kept); the runner/plan and loopback-server tests were added after the runner was written (disclosed)
required_results_and_rules.exclusions: only shakedown trials and trials whose Driver failed to start for an infrastructure reason recorded before step 1; every attempted trial stays in raw/ and the ledger

evidence_labels: every row carries one of SOURCE / UNIT / FIXTURE / REAL / BENCHMARK / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN; timing from REAL trials with the scripted chooser is BENCHMARK (chooser named); A-vs-B read cost and live provider are BLOCKED
